p.THE-PROJECT-HAS-A-DELIBERATE-LICENSING-P: This project has a **deliberate licensing posture**, decided once and recorded, not inherited from whatever a scaffold dropped in.

p.two-things-are-always-true-lead: Two things are always true and must not drift:

facts.ONE-STATED-PRODUCT-LICENCE: The product ships under one stated licence (a `LICENSE.md` at the repository root; every sub-package states the same in its manifest).
facts.EVERY-DEPENDENCY-STAYS-PERMISSIVE-ONLY: Every third-party dependency stays **permissive-only** — MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / Unlicense / equivalent. Strong copyleft (GPL / AGPL / LGPL) is forbidden by default; weak copyleft (MPL-2.0) is case-by-case.

p.a-dependencys-licence-mingles-with-the-p: A dependency's licence mingles with the product's.

p.A-STRICTER-PRODUCT-LICENCE-MAKES-THE-RUL: A proprietary or source-available product that links a copyleft library can be forced to relicense — so the stricter the product's own licence, the *more* important the permissive-only rule, not less.

p.REJECT-A-COPYLEFT-DEPENDENCY-ON-LICENCE-: Reject a copyleft dependency on licence grounds regardless of how good it is.

facts.WHEN-ADDING-A-DEPENDENCY: Adding a dependency: check its licence before adopting it. A non-permissive licence is a hard no by default; surface it.
facts.WHEN-CHANGING-THE-PRODUCTS-LICENCE: Changing the product's licence, or any bulk relicensing: this is an **owner decision** and an irreversible-threshold operation — never do it autonomously.
facts.WHEN-A-CHANGE-TOUCHES-ANY-LICENCE-STATEM: A change touching the licence file, the manifest `license` field, or the third-party carve-out updates all of them together, in one commit.

p.THE-DRAFT-EULA-SKILL-DRAFTS-OR-REVIEWS-T: The `draft-eula` skill drafts or reviews the posture.

facts.NEVER-ADD-A-COPYLEFT-DEPENDENCY-BY-DEFAU: Never add a GPL / AGPL / LGPL dependency by default — surface it as an owner decision.
facts.NEVER-RELICENSE-WITHOUT-THE-OWNERS-EXPLI: Never relicense the product, or any part of it, without the owner's explicit instruction.
facts.NEVER-LET-THE-MANIFEST-AND-THE-LICENCE-F: Never let the manifest `license` field and the `LICENSE.md` disagree.
facts.NEVER-REJECT-A-DEPENDENCY-FOR-BEING-TOO-: Never reject a dependency for being "too heavy" — weight is not a licence problem; licence is.
facts.NEVER-CLAIM-A-LICENCE-IS-PERMISSIVE-WITH: Never claim a licence is permissive without checking; when unsure, treat it as non-permissive and ask.
